purpose: Public synthetic practice questions for the Board Builder lesson-writer evaluation set.

provenance.source: Created for NavoX; no student work, private course material, or copied exam questions.
provenance.answerStatus: Analytically calculated expected answers, independently recomputed by the corpus integrity tests; subject-matter review remains a release gate.

qualification.note: Passing these tests does not establish the 95% lesson-script or answer-correctness targets, timing, or learning outcomes. Run and score an actual lesson writer separately. Coverage is introductory: 25 numeric problem families with four variants each, not comprehensive coverage of any subject.
